author: KingTodd
quote:
I've Beaten the original N64 game over 25 times since it came out in 1998.
Beaten 3DS version twice, and even played the N64 version on my PC with a Coop mod and recently a VR mod(really good).

At fist i was mix on the art design for Remake when it was first shown off.
once i seen more, it was actually good(grew on me).

As a game dev,  i loved how much detail and love went into optimizing and adding to this remake.

Some character design's are a little goofy and has not rubbed on me yet(like Adult zelda hair/look), but that is just me. XD
